verdict.rationale: The MI355X ships with a software ecosystem (ROCm, HIP runtime, AMD SMI), so a documented API reference is a fair question and the axis applies. The evidence shows only general documentation pages and learning guides, plus an llms.txt file. Nothing shows an interactive API reference with runnable examples, and the OpenAPI probes all returned 404.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can explore an interactive API reference with runnable examples
